context: A barista finalizes a wholesale contract with a B2B manager
purpose: Teach: 思惑/効力/働きかけ/態勢/利便/前年度/集積/産経新聞

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 葵さん、前年度比で見ても御社への豆の納入量は順調に伸びていますね。
lines.en: Aoi-san, even compared to the previous fiscal year, our bean deliveries to your shop have been growing steadily.
lines.style: Polite businesslike tone with a slightly warm opening remark.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。実は産経新聞の朝刊にも小さく取り上げていただいて、問い合わせが続々と入っているんです。
lines.en: Thank you. Actually, we were featured briefly in the Sankei Shimbun morning edition, and inquiries keep pouring in.
lines.style: Warm barista voice, mildly proud but professionally humble in delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど、その記事の効果は大きそうですね。本社側の思惑としても、納品態勢をもう一段強化したいと考えております。
lines.en: I see, that article seems to be having a real impact. From headquarters' intentions as well, we'd like to strengthen the delivery setup further.
lines.style: Measured corporate cadence, transitioning smoothly into the proposal's core.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こちらとしても、お客様の利便を第一に考えていますので、配送頻度を上げていただけるのは大歓迎です。
lines.en: On our end, we prioritize customer convenience, so increasing the delivery frequency would be very welcome.
lines.style: Engaged and cooperative, balancing barista warmth with negotiation poise.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 良かったです。倉庫の集積拠点を都内に移したことで、当日発送も可能になりました。
lines.en: That's great to hear. By relocating our consolidation hub to within Tokyo, same-day shipping is now possible.
lines.style: Confident and informative, briefly highlighting an operational improvement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それは助かります。実は産地の農家さんにも、品質を落とさないよう地道な働きかけを続けていただいているところでして。
lines.en: That's a big help. Actually, we've been having the growers steadily work on maintaining quality without compromise.
lines.style: Sincere craftsperson tone, sharing behind-the-scenes effort with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 素晴らしいですね。では、契約書はこちらでまとめて、来月一日から効力が発生する形でよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Wonderful. Then we'll prepare the contract on our side, with it taking effect from the first of next month.
lines.style: Formal closing cadence, confirming terms with crisp business politeness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、ぜひお願いします。長くお付き合いできるよう、こちらも全力で取り組ませていただきます。
lines.en: Yes, please go ahead. We'll do our utmost so that we can build a lasting partnership.
lines.style: Warm sign-off with genuine commitment, gracious barista hospitality showing through.
